metadata.title: Hentschel, Glimm, Glazier & Newman (2004) Proc. R. Soc. B / Kiskowski et al. (2004) Dev. Biol. — Multiscale TGF-beta, FGF, and Fibronectin Haptotaxis Chick Limb Chondrogenesis Reference Dataset

sources.citation: Hentschel HGE, Glimm T, Glazier JA, Newman SA (2004). Dynamical mechanisms for skeletal pattern formation in the vertebrate limb. Proceedings of the Royal Society B: Biological Sciences 271(1549):1713-1722.
Kiskowski MA, Alber MS, Glimm T, Hentschel HGE, Glazier JA, Newman SA (2004). A multiscale model for autonomous mesenchymal condensations. Developmental Biology 271(2):372-387.

Miura T, Shiota K (2000). TGF-beta2 acts as an activator molecule in reaction-diffusion model and is involved in cell sorting phenomenon in bar-like pattern formation of chick limb chondrogenesis in vitro. Developmental Dynamics 217(3):241-249.

Chaturvedi R, Huang C, Kazmierczak B, Schneider T, Izaguirre JA, Glimm T, Hentschel HGE, Glazier JA, Newman SA, Alber MS (2005). On multi-scale modeling of morphogenesis. Journal of the Royal Society Interface 2(3):237-253.
Christley S, Alber MS, Newman SA (2007). Patterning of developmental condensations by turing-type and haptotactic mechanisms in discrete and continuum models. BMC Systems Biology 1:16.

gallus_limb_chondrogenesis.species: Gallus gallus domesticus forelimb skeletal specimen (stylopod humerus 1 element -> zeugopod radius+ulna 2 elements -> autopod carpometacarpus/digits II-IV 3 elements)
gallus_limb_chondrogenesis.author: Conty / Wikimedia Commons

hentschel_2004_multiscale_pde_system.section: Hentschel, Glimm, Glazier & Newman (2004) Proc. R. Soc. B 271:1713-1722 Eqs. (2.1)-(3.14) & Kiskowski et al. (2004) Dev. Biol. 271:372-387

equations.tgfb_activator_pde: dc_a/dt = f_a(c_FGF) * c_a + f_i * c_i - c_a^3 + D_a * Lap(c_a)
equations.fgf_dependent_inhibitor_pde: dc_i/dt = g_a(c_FGF) * c_a + g_i * c_i + D_i * Lap(c_i)
equations.fibronectin_ecm_ode: dF/dt = k_F * max(0, c_a) * R_2(c_a, R) - gamma_F * F
equations.mesenchymal_haptotaxis_pde: dR/dt = D_R * Lap(R) - chi_F * div(R * grad(F)) + r_R * R * (1 - R)

proximodistal_fgf_zonation_regimes.empirical_source: Hentschel et al. (2004) Proc. R. Soc. B 271:1713-1722 Fig. 2 & Section 3 (low proximal FGF / large active zone -> m=1 single humerus condensation)
Hentschel et al. (2004) Proc. R. Soc. B 271:1713-1722 Fig. 3 & Section 3 (intermediate FGF / narrower active zone -> m=2 radius + ulna condensations)
Hentschel et al. (2004) Proc. R. Soc. B 271:1713-1722 Fig. 4 & Section 3 (distal AER-FGF / thin active zone -> m=3 chick wing digit condensations)
Hentschel et al. (2004) Proc. R. Soc. B 271:1713-1722 Section 4 & Miura & Shiota (2000) Dev. Dyn. 217:241-249 (high TGF-beta / hindlimb autopod -> m=4 condensations)

micromass_haptotaxis_perturbations.description: Standard high-density chick limb bud micromass culture (Kiskowski et al. 2004; Miura & Shiota 2000)
micromass_haptotaxis_perturbations.empirical_source: Kiskowski et al. (2004) Dev. Biol. 271:372-387 Figs. 4-6 (~25-30% nodular cartilage area fraction in chick micromass)

micromass_haptotaxis_perturbations.description: Exogenous TGF-beta2 treatment in micromass culture inducing bar-like/labyrinthine stripe fusion (Miura & Shiota 2000)
micromass_haptotaxis_perturbations.empirical_source: Miura & Shiota (2000) Dev. Dyn. 217:241-249 Figs. 1-3 (exogenous TGF-beta2 shifts nodular islands to bar-like trabecular stripes)

micromass_haptotaxis_perturbations.description: Anti-fibronectin antibody / RGD peptide blocking mesenchymal haptotaxis (chi_F = 0)
micromass_haptotaxis_perturbations.empirical_source: Kiskowski et al. (2004) Dev. Biol. 271:372-387 & Hentschel et al. (2004) Proc. R. Soc. B 271:1713-1722 (blocking fibronectin accumulation or cell-fibronectin haptotaxis abolishes mesenchymal cell condensation)
